title: Redis Performance Tuning: Pipeline, Slow Log, and What Actually Matters
description: Master Redis performance tuning. Learn pipelining, use SLOWLOG & LATENCY DOCTOR, detect big keys, and tune maxclients to fix your latency.
linkedinHook: Did your Redis P99 latency just spike to hundreds of milliseconds? I've seen it cripple entire services. Here's how you actually debug and fix it.
linkedinBody: We all hit Redis performance walls eventually. This post cuts through the noise, showing you how to really optimize your Redis usage with pipelining, diagnose issues with SLOWLOG and LATENCY DOCTOR, and identify critical problems like big keys. It's packed with practical advice to keep your systems blazing fast.
